utterance: Make a new Numbers spreadsheet with rent 1200, food 450 and transport 150, and a total under them using a sum formula.

check.shell:
d=$(mktemp)
if [ "$(osascript -e 'application id "com.apple.iWork.Numbers" is running')" = "true" ]; then osascript >> "$d" <<'OSA'
set out to ""
tell application id "com.apple.iWork.Numbers"
  repeat with d in documents
    repeat with s in sheets of d
      repeat with t in tables of s
        repeat with c in cells of t
          set v to value of c
          if v is not missing value then
            set f to ""
            try
              set f to formula of c
            end try
            if f is missing value then set f to ""
            set out to out & (name of c) & "|" & (v as text) & "|" & f & linefeed
          end if
        end repeat
      end repeat
    end repeat
  end repeat
end tell
return out
OSA
fi
if [ "$(osascript -e 'application id "com.apple.Numbers" is running')" = "true" ]; then osascript >> "$d" <<'OSA'
set out to ""
tell application id "com.apple.Numbers"
  repeat with d in documents
    repeat with s in sheets of d
      repeat with t in tables of s
        repeat with c in cells of t
          set v to value of c
          if v is not missing value then
            set f to ""
            try
              set f to formula of c
            end try
            if f is missing value then set f to ""
            set out to out & (name of c) & "|" & (v as text) & "|" & f & linefeed
          end if
        end repeat
      end repeat
    end repeat
  end repeat
end tell
return out
OSA
fi
python3 - "$d" all <<'PY'
import sys,re
rows=[l.split('|',2) for l in open(sys.argv[1]).read().splitlines() if l.count('|')>=2]
vals=[(n.strip(), v.strip(), f.strip()) for n,v,f in rows]
def num(v):
    v=v.replace(',','').replace('$','').strip()
    try: return float(v)
    except ValueError: return None
nums=[num(v) for _,v,_ in vals]
labels=' '.join(v.lower() for _,v,_ in vals)
part=sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else 'all'
ok_labels=all(w in labels for w in ('rent','food','transport'))
ok_nums=all(x in nums for x in (1200.0,450.0,150.0))
ok_total=any('sum' in f.lower() and num(v)==1800.0 for _,v,f in vals)
ok={'labels':ok_labels,'numbers':ok_nums,'total':ok_total}.get(part, ok_labels and ok_nums and ok_total)
print('PASS' if ok else 'FAIL labels=%s nums=%s total=%s cells=%s' % (ok_labels, ok_nums, ok_total, vals[:12]))
PY
rm -f "$d"
